description:
From 1993’s DOOM to today’s indie gaming: GZDoom has evolved far beyond its ‘boomer shooter’ roots into a full-featured, customizable game engine. Backed by decades of community-driven development, it’s an accessible and quirky alternative to modern game engines for retro-inspired projects.

In this session, you’ll learn the fundamentals of building with GZDoom, from setup and community tools to its powerful scripting engine. Along the way, we’ll explore what makes it unique and easy to build for, why indie developers still choose it today, and how a 30-year-old engine can fuel modern creativity. Whether you’re a curious beginner, a seasoned designer, or just a lapsed Doom fan, you’ll leave ready to rip and tear with something old-but-new.

-

Recorded in Hall 1B of The ICC Belfast, Northern Ireland
NIDC 2025 - Saturday, 8th November 2025
title: Retro Modern Game Development with GZDoom - Neil McCallion - Hall 1B - NIDC 2025
